title: Find your starting point
outcome: Trace one request and choose only the bridges you need.

title: Run one small mechanism
outcome: Prepare the environment and distinguish infrastructure success from learner completion.

title: Give each layer one responsibility
outcome: Follow data through the package without mixing HTTP, policy and storage.

title: Make access fail closed
outcome: Implement a dependency that rejects missing and invalid keys without leaking secrets.

title: Treat an upload as untrusted bytes
outcome: Reject unsupported or oversized content before storing it.

title: Separate client names from storage keys
outcome: Store under server-controlled paths and explain partial failures.

title: Keep metadata durable and queries parameterized
outcome: Trace the supplied repository and its atomic claim.

title: Make failure visible
outcome: Define valid state changes and a bounded retry policy.

title: Return acceptance before processing
outcome: Use BackgroundTasks while explaining its lifetime and limits.

title: Move scheduling across a process boundary
outcome: Explain Redis/RQ and write a concrete migration note; optionally run a local queue.

title: Assemble the ingestion use case
outcome: Implement the project contract one observable slice at a time.

title: Probe the boundary as a client
outcome: Distinguish CORS, authentication and rate limiting, then test uploads manually.

title: Prove ownership and retain it
outcome: Debug, explain and vary the complete in-scope work independently.
